title: Polygon
statementMd:
Polycarpus loves convex polygons, especially if all their angles are the same and all their sides are different. Draw for him any such polygon with the given number of vertexes.

## Input

The input contains a single integer $*n*$ ($3 ≤ *n* ≤ 100$) — the number of the polygon vertexes.

## Output

Print $*n*$ lines, containing the coordinates of the vertexes of the $*n*$-gon "$*x*_{*i*}$ $*y*_{*i*}$" in the counter clockwise order. The coordinates of the vertexes shouldn't exceed $10^{6}$ in their absolute value. The side lengths should fit within limits $[1, 1000]$ (not necessarily integer). Mutual comparing sides and angles of your polygon during the test will go with precision of $10^{ - 3}$.

If there is no solution, print "No solution" (without the quotes).
statementZhMd:
Polycarpus 喜欢凸多边形，尤其是所有角都相等且所有边长都不相同的凸多边形。请为他绘制一个具有给定顶点数的这样的多边形。

## 输入

输入包含一个整数 $*n*$（$3 ≤ *n* ≤ 100$）——多边形的顶点数。

## 输出

输出 $*n*$ 行，每行包含一个 $*n*$ 边形的顶点坐标 "$*x*_{*i*}$ $*y*_{*i*}$"，顶点按逆时针顺序排列。顶点坐标的绝对值不应超过 $10^{6}$。边长应满足范围 $[1, 1000]$（不一定是整数）。测试过程中，将以 $10^{ - 3}$ 的精度比较你所输出多边形的边和角。

如果无解，输出 "No solution"（不含引号）。
